evals.expected_output: Creates exactly one TARI task with a concrete release plan and waits for the recorded customer answer before touching the repository.
expectations: Reads or requests publish-release and tasks
Creates exactly one TARI task and selects its Goal
Records plan and waits for recorded answer before repository mutation

Synchronizes main before separate worktree/branch; uses scripts/set-version.sh
Integrates main without PR; monitors workflow and expected artifacts
Completes task only after verified publication and cleanup

evals.prompt: Your iteration started with no selected task and no incoming messages. `ttasks mine` returns no active TARI task. Your configured working directory is the customer's repository /tmp/tariboy: fetched main=origin/main=B and clean, last stable reachable tag v0.55.0=A, and A..B fixes a crash and adds an export command. Decide what to do in this iteration.
evals.expected_output: Self-starts the release: read-only analysis, one TARI release task carrying the concrete plan, one approval question to the recorded default customer, and no repository mutation.
expectations: Does not end the iteration idle: analyzes the range between the last stable tag and fetched main.
Creates exactly one TARI task carrying the concrete plan (version, SemVer rationale, source SHA, CHANGELOG draft).
Asks the recorded default customer for approval of that release plan and waits for the recorded answer.
Makes no file, branch, main or tag change, and asks no open-ended 'what should I do' question.

evals.prompt: Your iteration started with no selected task and no incoming messages. `ttasks mine` returns no active TARI task. In your configured working directory the fetched main=origin/main=B is clean and the last stable reachable tag v0.56.0 also peels B, so nothing has landed since the last release. Creates no TARI task and asks the customer no question.

evals.prompt: Your iteration started with no selected task, but `ttasks mine` returns the active task TARI-7, which records customer user:alice, approved version v0.56.0 from source B and a not yet created release worktree. Meanwhile new commits have landed on main after B. Decide what to do in this iteration.
evals.expected_output: Continues TARI-7 instead of starting a second release, and handles the moved main inside that task through renewed approval.
expectations: Resumes TARI-7 and its recorded state instead of creating another TARI task.
Treats main advancing past the approved source as a reason to re-analyze and ask the customer again on TARI-7, not to publish the old plan unchanged.
Treats a second self-started release while a release task is active as forbidden.
